leakage.basis: inputs dated by assumed_available_at (scheduled start + 4 h); the source never recorded when it first published each game

attribution: NHL game data: sportsdataverse fastRhockey (compiled from the NHL's public game feeds). sportsdataverse/fastRhockey-nhl-data and -raw are MIT-licensed repositories; the game data inside them is compiled from the NHL's public game feeds and remains the NHL's. NHL.com terms restrict commercial use of its content: the owner must review this before NHL output is sold in a paid tier. Attribution is printed on every NHL artifact.

total.settles: includes overtime; the shootout winner is credited one goal

uncertainty.basis: spread of the home win probability and expected total across the validated variants (chosen model, goals-only, goalie-aware under each projected goalie pairing, lineup-aware with each club's last lineup). A sensitivity, not a confidence interval.

lineups.basis: each club's previous game's dressed skaters against its typical lineup (box scores; hockey/model/lineups.js). Confirmed lineups are known only at warmups, and no pregame lineup feed is wired.

lineups.note: The price uses the chosen model (ratings only). The lineup-aware variant is a sensitivity: projected lineups did not clear the selection bar; confirmed lineups changed held-out log loss by -0.000895 (95% CI -0.001693 to -0.000052).

invalidators: A starting goalie other than the projected one (see the goalie scenarios for the size of the move).

A price posted by a book that settles the market differently (a 60-minute line is not the 2-way moneyline).
A back-to-back: the second-game effect is in the model, but the rested starter decision is not known yet.
